acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce that changed spec metadata requires the existing internal/specindex consistency check, preserving actual uncertainty for unsupported selection.

Ensure the supported focused-selection or spec verification path includes the real index/digest/README contract check for its relevant changed inputs without falsely describing requirements-only checks as equivalent.
Retain a negative mismatch witness and positive aligned witness; preserve unrelated selection and gate contracts.
body:
Confirmed focused-verification gap while fixing GitHub #378. Public878d36d6 (Corvint task branch, Go1.27.1) changed docs/specs/INDEX.json to a217-character claim differing from Agent digest and README. Focused runtime tests and requirements-script check passed, but CI internal/specindex TestIndexCoversSpecsAndHeaders failed length<=160 and digest/README consistency. Existing script is a requirements check, not evidence that the full index contract passed. Latest installed tools at observation: Corvint1.0.0-rc.1 build163; standaloneTasks0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build202. Dedup searches specindex/spec index found no matching open selection ticket; V1-0029 is completed older metadata drift. Expected: changing INDEX.json or spec Agent digest/README selects the actual specindex consistency check early. Actual: focused plan omitted it and discovered error only in long CI. Evidence /tmp/corvint-378/ci-shard3-failure.log and metadata-correction proposal/test logs. Current #378 defect is already being corrected; this ticket is the durable selection/test coverage gap.

## Reviewed repair and prevention, 2026-10-04
PR #496 now has exact head dd670a65d2ff2c05118a0bc122a2dee972ba33bf. Additive inverse seal 68de4c1c090eba5379a102e31f39010c9f2a4e2f preserved the prior sealed binding; repaired source commit 644804f20ff228a4c43eb24f2b116c2c3fee120a and binding 91cdf2f1a8beb303f549d4c3d9aac085edf7eba8 precede the pure R100 seal. Root verified all 271 final artifact hashes, the five-path diff, unchanged six Owner source files and unchanged INDEX/REQUIREMENTS blobs. All four same-key frozen checks qualified; clean change/check/seal passed. CEM has 13 supported hunks, zero unknown; OCM 0/5 linked, all unassessed, and TestExecution NOT_RUN remain explicit.
The durable prevention adds the actual internal/specindex package test to spec-requirements-check. The known broken metadata produced all six expected diagnostics before the fix; corrected metadata passes the same explicit check and docs route. Evidence: /private/tmp/corvint-owner-pr496-doc-repair-20261003/ROOT-FINAL-REVIEW.json and retained terminal manifest. Native attempt 257 returned at receipt2449 after process retirement. New exact-head CI docs/interoperability/security passed; product shards and artifact integrity were still pending at 03:29 UTC. Integration, any broader acceptance requirements and native completion remain pending. No failed record was rewritten and no qualification limit was removed.
title: Tests: select spec-index consistency checks when spec metadata changes
